method: Independent model subject-role/valency review of every one of the 1345 actual selected English-source ordinary-profile finite senses and 655 Apertium finite pairs, in bounded sequential batches. Read source glosses/tags, selected contexts and pertinent notes/examples; morphology pairs additionally judged from Spanish lexical knowledge where no definition exists. No source presence alone establishes a human-capable agent, no personification or invented human figurative use, and no implied patient inserted into a middle object slot. Keep means no subject-role/mandatory-complement blocker identified in this bounded audit, not certification of all senses, tenses or translation quality. It-only is a conservative third-person-singular subset for a source-supported literal entity/animal agent; it does not authorize imperatives, personal forms, a new sense or an unproved causative operator. Human operators acting on entities, human bodily processes, conventional crew/rider uses and genuinely human-capable readings were distinguished from entity-only agents. Uncertain definition-free pair valency/sense cases are withheld with a request for specific source evidence. Selected elliptical meanings retain all preexisting source/tense/aspect/AGID/clitic guards; no independent source quotations, native-human certification or actual-coverage claim is made. Flagged changes require the planned cross-review before production. No app edits.

restrict.reason: Source explicitly restricts this gait to quadrupeds; literal animal it is a safe narrow subset, personal subjects require unsupported personification.
Literal nesting supports an animal/entity subject. No human figurative nesting reading is evidenced in this selected source sense; restrict to it.
Source explicitly says a bird running; only literal animal it is supported, not I/you running.

Selected intransitive mechanical tilting/oscillation reading does not attest a person tilting their body. Restrict to entity it; a human-operated transitive tilt reading would be distinct.
Selected glow reading provides no human figurative or experiential sense. Literal luminous entity it is supported; human I glow requires separately attested source context.
Source explicitly limits the soaking agent to a liquid; only liquid/entity it is supported, not a person soaking an object.
Selected spouting/gushing reading is literal flowing liquid; no human speech/enthusiasm reading is evidenced for Spanish chorrear. Restrict to entity it.
Selected absorb reading supports an absorbing material/entity; human chupar as sucking is a different action. No independently evidenced human absorb reading here.

Literal cocear kicking is animal hind-leg kicking in the conservative selected reading. Human kick use needs specific source evidence; animal it is a safe narrow subset.

withhold.reason: The fixed frame ends in obligatory recipient preposition to; generated I give water to lacks its complement. Select a complete source-faithful frame or withhold.

Selected abound reading gives no human-capable personal use or required in-complement. Human populations being numerous does not substantiate singular I abound; require compatible subjects or source-proved construction.
Put into motion requires a direct object between put and into; single-head rendering omits that object.
Bring close requires the thing brought between bring and close; the fixed frame cannot supply that middle object.
Place next to or against leaves both the thing placed and the locative complement unresolved; not a complete subject-preserving fixed clause.
Flow into leaves an obligatory destination complement and no independently attested human-capable source reading; literal entity subjects do not justify I flow into.
Make happy requires a middle direct object; I make happy cannot express causing another person happiness.
Make bitter requires the patient between make and bitter; do not produce I make bitter.
Make pleasant requires a middle patient object; no supported complete clause is rendered.

Spanish amoscar can describe an insect biting; the terse English nip/bite record does not independently establish human-agent use. Require sense-specific Spanish evidence rather than infer it from English bite.
Spy on leaves the obligatory object of on absent; render a complete source-faithful frame or withhold.
Terse border mapping does not distinguish a geographic entity bordering something from a person skirting it or adding a border. Require sense-specific evidence rather than generate I border.
Call out for ends in an obligatory complement preposition; I call out for is incomplete without what is requested.

Selected leave means place an object somewhere, not depart. Without its object/location the generated I leave/left defaults to a different intransitive sense; require a supported complete placement frame.
Become is a copula requiring a predicative complement; I become by itself does not express the selected source meaning.
Make ill requires the patient between make and ill; the fixed frame omits this mandatory middle object.
Atone for ends in an obligatory complement preposition; without the offense or guilt complement the fixed clause is incomplete.
Source allows snoop with optional on, but the selected frame fixes on without its object. I snoop on is incomplete; use a separately approved complete frame.
Make equal requires a middle direct object; I make equal does not express equalizing something.

Selected source sense is explicitly tagged reflexive. Nonpronominal llevar clothing may be independently valid, but that does not authorize stripping this selected source construction; require a matching nonreflexive sense proof.
Make better requires the thing improved between make and better; the fixed clause omits that object.
Put in as insert requires the inserted patient and normally a location; I put in alone instead invites another sense. No supported complete insertion frame is provided.
Agree upon ends in an obligatory object preposition. I agree upon without a matter agreed on is incomplete; a complete separately approved frame is needed.
Step on leaves the stepped-on surface as an obligatory prepositional complement. I step on is incomplete without that object.
Be able to fixes an unfinished infinitive marker without its action. Standalone I am/was able to requires a separately controlled ellipsis or a complete predicate; not authorized here.
Selected put/place requires a patient and spatial/predicative complement; I put alone cannot express the source sense.
Selected resultative be requires a state/location complement. Standalone I am/was does not express quedar's resultative meaning.
Resort to ends in an obligatory complement preposition; I resort to is incomplete without what is resorted to.
Give as a present requires the gift object before as; the fixed frame omits this middle object.
Clear of brush requires the land/patient between clear and of; the fixed clause omits that mandatory middle object.
Be worth requires a value or evaluative complement; I am worth alone is incomplete. A complete source-faithful frame or controlled ellipsis is needed.
Spy on leaves the obligatory watched object absent. I spy on is incomplete without a separately approved complement or frame.

Apertium span lacks sense evidence distinguishing an entity extending across a range from a human covering/taking in things. Require a source-attested human subject/argument reading before personal finite rendering.

Definition-free bastar/suffice does not establish the personal sufficiency construction versus an impersonal/dative sufficiency reading. Request source evidence for the exact human-capable frame before expanding personal subjects.
Culminate normally makes an event reach its endpoint or requires in/with, while Spanish can mean a human completing a task. Request exact sense and valency evidence rather than generate I culminate.
Devote normally requires a patient and a to-complement; definition-free dedicar does not establish a complete fixed human clause. Request a source-bound complete frame.
Personal depend normally requires an on/upon construction. The definition-free pair does not establish the dependency roles or a complete personal fixed clause; request source-bound valency evidence.
Empotrar as embedding and English bed need a patient/location construction. Bare I bed also suggests unrelated sleeping/sexual senses; request the exact technical source frame.

Rare ensenar is not enseñar; the pair alone does not establish whether anchoring, entering an inlet, or another nautical action is meant. Request specific source/crew-role evidence before finite rendering.
Transfer-by-hand requires the handed patient and recipient/construction; the definition-free pair hand does not establish a complete fixed clause. Request exact source valency rather than I hand.
Put as insertion needs the patient and a location/predicative complement. Bare I put/let's put does not express meter's placement meaning.
Seem requires a predicative or infinitival complement. Bare I seem is incomplete; no complete frame is supplied.
Pasar maps to spend in a time-spending construction, not generic financial spending. The pair omits that required time/content context; request a source-bound complete frame rather than I spend.

Haunt can make a memory/ghost the agent while Spanish perseguir can make a human pursuer the agent. This definition-free pair does not bind the exact human-capable sense; request specific source evidence.
Resort in this sense needs to plus what is resorted to. The fixed bare predicate leaves its mandatory construction unsupported.

Refer can require to or describe a medical referral, while nonpronominal referir also means narrate and referirse means refer to. Request exact nonpronominal sense/valency evidence before generic personal rendering.
Subject as someter needs a patient and a to-complement describing the treatment/control. No complete fixed construction is supplied; request sense-bound valency evidence.
Situate normally needs both the positioned patient and where it is placed. The definition-free pair does not establish a complete fixed clause; request a source-bound frame.

revisions.previousReason: Selected reviewed context explicitly makes a male animal the fertilizing subject. Restrict this reading to animal it; a human inseminating livestock is a potentially distinct operator reading needing its own source/context proof.
revisions.reason: Corrected agent/patient distinction. Retained Spanish record 21dec81f9ac31b16ddd8393f7a970e5275878e08c182a2e1bd407302710762b9 describes fertilizing the female and causing a pregnancy. This causal transitive reading allows a human operator to cause pregnancy in an animal; neither those definitions nor English for animals restrict the agent to a male animal. Preserve the animal-patient reproductive meaning and ordinary human-causer subjects. Do not infer human patients, the experiencer becoming pregnant, or a mandatory male-animal agent. The authored male-animal-agent context is narrower than the source and must not be treated as an attested source restriction.
